name: Chicken Zucchini Casserole (Creamy Gruyere Bake)
method: oven bake (sear chicken/veg on stovetop, combine with cream + cheese, bake to bubbly)
ingredients_verbatim: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (cut into 1-inch pieces)
3/4 tsp sea salt (divided into 1/2 tsp and 1/4 tsp)
6 oz Swiss Gruyere shredded cheese blend (divided)
unmapped: gruyere/swiss cheese blend (board has generic shredded-cheese, sliced-cheese; no dedicated gruyere id)
why: Chicken + zucchini + mushroom bake bound by cream, sour cream and melted cheese, zero starch base.
